title: Membership renewal reminder
description: Warn members that their membership renews soon, with the date and amount. Renewal reminder WhatsApp template for gyms. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Renewal notices tied to an existing plan are utility when they avoid upsell wording. State the amount and date.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your {{plan}} membership renews on {{date}} for {{amount}}. No action needed, or you can update your plan anytime.
